title: Patient Payment Plan Late Fee Share for Patients in Active Therapy on an Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Revenue Cycle standard — treatment share of a Patient Payment Plan missed-installment late fee**

A treatment share follows the patient's therapy on their Insured Plans of Care: where at least one visit was billed within the last 1 month on any of the patient's plans of care and no patient statement was issued on any of them within the last 6 months, the share is 0.8; where a visit was billed within the last 1 month and a statement was issued within the last 6 months, the share is 0.9; where no visit was billed within the last 1 month the treatment share is one. The missed-installment late fee of the Patient Payment Plan is multiplied by the treatment share.

**Records read.** The billed-visit entries and the issued patient-statement entries on every Insured Plan of Care held by the patient, each placed by the date it was recorded. An entry falls within the last N months when fewer than N whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date.

## Truth table

| Visit billed within the last 1 month (any Insured Plan of Care of the patient) | Patient statement issued within the last 6 months (any of those plans) | Treatment share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | 0.8 |
| Yes | Yes | 0.9 |
| No | No | 1 |
| No | Yes | 1 |

## Boundary readings (hypothetical dates, handling date 2026-08-20)

- A visit billed 2026-07-21 lies less than 1 whole calendar month before the handling date: it is within the last 1 month. A visit billed 2026-07-20 lies exactly 1 whole month before: it is not.
- A statement issued 2026-02-21 is within the last 6 months; one issued 2026-02-20 is not.
- A patient with a visit billed 2026-08-05 and the latest statement issued 2026-01-10: share 0.8.
